landing-display.purpose: Public landing headline; compact and high impact.

landing-mono.purpose: Landing navigation, captions, and action label.

body.purpose: Shared workspace family; zero letter spacing.

conventions.tokens: Primitives and component tokens are owned by DESIGN.md frontmatter; final CSS overrides and specificity govern effective values.
conventions.dialog: Native showModal(), labeled heading, body scroll lock, Escape and outside-bounds click routed through close callback, previous focus restored on unmount. Dirty-draft discard confirmation is specific to the draft editor.
conventions.keyboard: Skip link targets main. Mobile navigation wraps Tab and Shift+Tab, closes on Escape, restores menu-button focus, and uses inert for unavailable regions. View switches are ordinary buttons without arrow-key tab navigation.
conventions.reducedMotion: At prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, all elements and pseudo-elements receive animation: none !important; transition: none !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important. Static pressed transforms remain.
conventions.landing: The public root route uses exact #000, white halftone artwork, and a single green action. The operational workspace continues the black canvas with lifted near-black surfaces.
conventions.responsive: Tables scroll horizontally. Case rail appears visually before main at <=1050px and after main at <=470px; DOM order remains unchanged. Mobile drawer begins at <=760px.

narrative.overview: ClaimChain opens with an exact-black, full-viewport public landing surface framed by white halftone hands. The operational product continues with exact-black canvases, lifted near-black work surfaces, pale text, green actions, and blue and amber workflow states. Manrope, compact navigation, ruled registers, and restrained panels establish a practical, information-dense environment. The signature case view places evidence beside live payment reconciliation.
keyCharacteristics: Black surfaces and fine dark-neutral dividers organize the workspace.
Green identifies primary actions and recovery progress.
Dense registers, explicit status labels, and aligned financial figures support scanning.
Evidence, balances, and next actions share the case workspace.
Restrained motion and native controls support repeat operations.
